name: dessn
description: The visual layer for designing and building with your agent: see your real app live on a Dessn canvas, spot where screens drift from your design system, and map whole user journeys.

interface.shortDescription: The visual layer for your app
interface.longDescription:
Dessn is the visual layer for designing and building with your agent. Every frame on a Dessn canvas is your real app, running live from its own code, so your agent can show you the work instead of describing it.

• See what's live: put every screen of your app on one page, grouped by area, and click through any of them.
• See what's drifting: audit screens against your app's own components and tokens, with a note pinned where each one drifts.
• Map entire journeys: lay out a user flow as a board of real screens, labelled arrows and notes your team can comment on.
• Explore without risk: each variation is a copy of a frame, its own running app, side by side with the original.
• Bring it home: take a design back to your repository as a git patch.

Reading your canvas and changing boards use no credits; asking Dessn's design agent to design something does. You need a Dessn account (create.dessn.ai); a new account can start from a starter app. From a web chat your agent reads code and lays out boards, and asks Dessn's design agent for code changes; an agent on your own computer can also edit a frame's code and capture a live site.
